questions.q: If for $x \in \left(0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right), {\log}_{10}sinx + {\log}_{10}cosx = - 1$ and ${\log}_{10}\left(sinx + cosx\right) = \dfrac{1}{2}\left({\log}_{10}n - 1\right), n > 0$, then the value of $n$ is equal to :
questions.solution:
Given $x \in \left(0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$

${\log}_{10}sinx + {\log}_{10}cosx = - 1$

$⇒ {\log}_{10}sinx . cosx = - 1$

$⇒ sinx . cosx = \dfrac{1}{10}$ $. . . ( 1 )$

${\log}_{10}\left(sinx + cosx\right) = \dfrac{1}{2}\left({\log}_{10}n - 1\right)$

$⇒ sinx + cosx = {10}^{\left({\log}_{10}\sqrt{n} - \dfrac{1}{2}\right)} = {10}^{\left({\log}_{10}\sqrt{n} - {\log}_{10}\sqrt{10}\right)} = \sqrt{\dfrac{n}{10}}$

By squaring we get,

$\sin^{2}x + \cos^{2}x + 2sinxcosx = \dfrac{n}{10}$

$1 + 2sinx . cosx = \dfrac{n}{10}$

$⇒ 1 + \dfrac{1}{5} = \dfrac{n}{10} ⇒ n = 12$

questions.q: Let $S = \left\{x \in \left[- 6, 3\right] - \left\{- 2, 2\right\}: \dfrac{\left|x + 3\right| - 1}{\left|x\right| - 2} \ge 0\right\}$ and $T = \left\{x \in Z: {x}^{2} - 7\left|x\right| + 9 \le 0\right\}$. Then the number of elements in $S ∩ T$ is
questions.solution:
Given, ${\left|x\right|}^{2} - 7\left|x\right| + 9 \le 0$

$⇒ \left|x\right| \le \dfrac{7 \pm \sqrt{13}}{2}$

$⇒ \left|x\right| \in \left[\dfrac{7 - \sqrt{13}}{2}, \dfrac{7 + \sqrt{13}}{2}\right]$

Also given $x \in \text{Integers}$, so $x$ can be $\pm 2, \pm 3, \pm 4, \pm 5$

Now out of these values of $x$ only $3, - 4, - 5$ will satisfy $S = \dfrac{\left|x + 3\right| - 1}{\left|x\right| - 2} \ge 0$

So, $S ∩ T \in \left\{3, - 4, - 5\right\}$

So, $n\left(S ∩ T\right) = 3$
